item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Lovely to see you. Welcome to your weather report for Thursday, October 8. It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be part sun and part cloud. The high will be 25 degrees, and the low will be 14 degrees. It should feel gently warm all day. You probably won't need a raincoat today. The sun goes down at 5:30 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? A great day for the garden, or for drawing with chalk outside. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be damp with light drizzle, reaching 25 degrees. This week is all about teachers. What is your favourite part? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
